text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and closing restatement","quality":"organization","description":"The essay more clearly frames a position and returns to it at the end, giving the argument a recognizable beginning, middle, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"separate safety and environment paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"It develops multiple reasons in fuller body paragraphs instead of mostly listing ideas, so its support feels more extended and explained."},{"evidence":"“sensors seemingly everywhere... real life, real time model”","quality":"explanation of evidence","description":"It does more to connect article details to its claim by explaining how the technology works to prevent accidents."},{"evidence":"“road work, avoiding accidents, and other things, people will take over”","quality":"nuance","description":"It acknowledges the limits of driverless cars and the need for human intervention, which makes the argument more balanced and credible."},{"evidence":"fewer run-on ideas and clearer paragraphing","quality":"coherence","description":"Its sentences and paragraphs stay more focused on one point at a time, making the argument easier to follow."}]}
